profile.headline: Senior Director at Spotify
profile.summary: I am an accomplished leader, analyst, and mentor with over twenty years of experience delivering quantifiable business results in the areas of customer service, human capital analysis, financial planning, forecasting and workforce management.

positions.title: Senior Director, Global Planning and Analysis
positions.description:
I lead release management, forecasting, workforce management, budgeting, tech ops, and data science for Spotify customer service. My teams are responsible for:

• Understanding all future product and marketing initiatives, and ensuring that customer service teams have the tools and knowledge they need to support those launches.

• Accurately forecasting customer service demand across all markets that Spotify supports (180+). 

• Converting forecasts into staffing models which minimize customer wait times while optimizing for other factors such as customer language preferences and geographic redundancy.

• Managing customer service operating expenses, and ensuring that our long-term support strategy is aligned with Spotify's financial goals.

• Real-time monitoring and response for customer service tools and advisor staffing.

• Data engineering, analysis, and reporting in support of customer service operations, and providing quantitative + qualitative feedback to Spotify product teams about how their features impact the customer experience.

positions.title: Director, Customer Service Analytics and Workforce Management
Head of Global Workforce Analytics
positions.description:
My team's mission is to create value for AOL by measuring the effectiveness of our HR programs and processes, analyzing both leading and lagging workforce metrics, and identifying areas of opportunity to help create a more engaged and productive workforce.

We use unique technologies and methodologies to glean insights into AOL's most valuable resource--its employees. (OLAP cubes, monthly engagement surveys, regression analysis, etc.)

My team was instrumental in driving adoption of a new BI platform at AOL (Tableau + Tableau Server), and we use the tool to deliver reporting and analysis to every level of the business, from the executive team to the most junior intern.

positions.title: Senior Workforce Analyst
positions.description: Provide regular updates on the progress of AOL's people strategy through measures and analyses while quantifying the financial implications and benefits of HR initiatives.  Advocate analytic best practices, tools and techniques (statistical sampling, data visualization, storytelling with data, Tableau Software, etc.)

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description: Managed staffing models and SG&A forecast model for AOL's entire network of internal and partner-managed call centers.  Contribution valuation analysis for key performance indicators.
